description: ForgeAI Agent behavioral evaluation suite for repository-based software engineering investigation.

cases.name: Repository Purpose Overview
cases.question: Explain the overall purpose of this repository. Use repository files to identify what types of files it contains, and cite relevant sources.

cases.name: Repository Structure Discovery
cases.question: How is this repository structured and organized at the root directory level? List the files and describe what you observe.

cases.name: Specific File Inspection (Joomla.gitignore)
cases.question: What specific file patterns and rules are configured in Joomla.gitignore?

cases.name: Evidence Distinction (Template vs Application)
cases.question: Is this repository itself a Joomla web application codebase, or does it merely contain a Joomla gitignore template? Explain based strictly on repository evidence.

cases.name: Search-Required Code Investigation
cases.question: Use code search to find which gitignore files in this repository contain patterns for ignoring crash logs or log files, and cite the files found.

cases.name: Read-File Content Inspection (Python.gitignore)
cases.question: Read Python.gitignore and explain what bytecode, cache, and virtual environment directory patterns are excluded.

cases.name: Grounding Requirement (Absence of Makefile)
cases.question: Does this repository include a custom Makefile for building C/C++ binary targets? Verify using repository evidence before answering.

cases.name: Multi-Step Multi-File Investigation
cases.question: Identify three different programming language templates in this repository (e.g. Java, Python, C++), inspect their contents, and compare the types of build artifacts they ignore.

cases.name: Repository-Specific Factual Rules (Node.gitignore)
cases.question: What specific rules and comments are defined in Node.gitignore regarding node_modules, logs, and environment files?

cases.name: Sequential Discovery & Inspection (C++.gitignore)
cases.question: List the root files to confirm C++.gitignore exists, then read C++.gitignore and cite the object file extensions it excludes.
